general.name: ScreenConnect - Find and Remove Rogue Clients [Win]
general.description:
Finds ScreenConnect clients that aren't ours plus RelayTrap persistence; Remove mode deletes them. Detect only writes the optional UDF.
Source: https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components/tree/main/Scripts/screenconnect-find-and-remove-rogue-clients-win

variables.name: usrMode
variables.description: Detect = read-only report. Remove = delete every ScreenConnect client not in usrKnownThumbprints, and the RelayTrap persistence.

variables.name: usrKnownThumbprints
variables.description: Our ScreenConnect instance thumbprint(s): the 16 hex characters in the service name ScreenConnect Client (...). Comma-separated. Required for Remove.

variables.name: usrKnownRelayHosts
variables.description: Our relay host name(s), comma-separated: the relay= value a Detect run prints for our client. Required for Remove.

variables.name: usrUdfNumber
variables.description: UDF to write a one-line summary to, 1 to 300. Blank = write no UDF.

variables.name: usrOverwriteForeign
variables.description: No = leave the UDF alone if it holds a value this component did not write. Yes = overwrite it.

variables.name: usrCheckDefenderExclusions
variables.description: Yes = report Defender exclusions that look like evasion (never changes them). No = skip.
